free_tier.stated: No platform cap at all: `body_limit_size` and `[files.limit]` live in Revolt.toml and are yours to set. Storage is whatever disk/MinIO you attach to Autumn.

egress.terms: Whatever your own host costs — not free, so this is self-hosting rather than a free tier.

tooling: Docker Compose stack (stoatchat/self-hosted), Autumn file service with S3/MinIO backend, full Revolt/Stoat API so all existing clients and bots work unchanged.
chaining: N/A — the multiplier is disk, not accounts. It is a reference architecture rather than a free provider.
limits_note: `body_limit_size = 20_000_000` is the shipped default (must exceed any per-file limit); `max_size = 20000000` in Autumn.toml is the per-file cap. Multiple users report editing Autumn.toml alone does not raise the limit — body_limit_size in Revolt.toml must move too.
reliability_note: Self-hosted means the data is yours, but the project has had repeated breaking migrations (Autumn refactor 2024-09-30, breaking changes 2024-11-28) that require manual DB work.
confidence_note: Re-read 2026-10-22: the page answers and the claim holds; the rung is unchanged because the read establishes the page, not the enforcement.
